analysis.title: GS Futures Global Bonds CTA - Market Update - November 09, 2026
key_insights: GS Futures Sales Strats estimates trend followers (CTAs) are short $85mm DV01 of global rates as trend strengthens across the global rates complex.
The desk forecasts CTAs will buy about $41mm DV01 of global rates this week, roughly double last week's daily flow forecast size of about $20mm DV01.
The desk expects CTAs to buy as much as $95.5mm DV01 of rates over the course of the month.
Forecast flows are biased toward the back end of the curve. In the US, 30y flow forecasts are 2x the size of 2y and 10y forecasts.
In Germany, 5y forecast flows are 4x the size of 2y flows, and 10y flows are roughly 6x the size of 2y flows.
vol_and_positioning: CTA positioning in global rates is estimated at short $85mm DV01 as of the 9 Nov 2026 note.
Estimated CTA buying this week is about $41mm DV01 of global rates, versus daily flow forecasts of about $20mm DV01 last week.
Estimated CTA buying over the month is up to $95.5mm DV01.
Forecast CTA flows concentrate in longer maturities: US 30y at 2x the 2y and 10y, German 5y at 4x the 2y, German 10y at roughly 6x the 2y.
